# handbook-knowledge

The handbook-knowledge bundled feature: a fixed handbook JSON served to the AI assistant as list-pages and read-page query tools.

## README

# Handbook knowledge

Serves the app's handbook to the AI assistant. `kumiko handbuch knowledge` exports
the pages per locale as JSON; the `handbook-knowledge` bundled feature mounts them
as two query tools, so the assistant can answer how-do-I questions from the real
handbook text.

## What it shows

- **Feature** — `createHandbookKnowledgeFeature({ pages, access, publicPath })`.
  No entity, no migration; `access` decides which roles see the tools.
- **list-pages** — catalog of id, kind, title and questions in the caller's language.
- **read-page** — one page body; the language falls back to the handbook's default
  language, long pages are cut with a visible notice, unknown ids are `not_found`.
- **Test** — `setupTestStack` and HTTP with an `X-Locale` header.

## Files

```
src/feature.ts                              fixed handbook JSON and the feature
src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts   list-pages, read-page, fallback, not found
```

## Source files

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createTestUser } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { handbookKnowledgeFeature } from "../feature";

const LIST_PAGES = "handbook-knowledge:query:list-pages";
const READ_PAGE = "handbook-knowledge:query:read-page";

type ListResult = { locale: string; pages: { id: string; title: string }[] };
type ReadResult = { id: string; locale: string; bodyMd: string; publicPath?: string };

const user = createTestUser({ roles: ["User"] });
let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [handbookKnowledgeFeature] });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

async function queryIn<T>(type: string, payload: unknown, locale: string): Promise<T> {
  const res = await stack.http.queryWithHeaders(type, payload, user, { "X-Locale": locale });
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  return ((await res.json()) as { data: T }).data;
}

describe("handbook-knowledge recipe", () => {
  test("list-pages returns the catalog in the caller's language", async () => {
    const de = await queryIn<ListResult>(LIST_PAGES, {}, "de");
    expect(de.pages[0]).toMatchObject({ id: "prozess-add-tenant", title: "Mieter hinzufügen" });
  });

  test("read-page falls back to the default language and links the public handbook", async () => {
    const page = await queryIn<ReadResult>(READ_PAGE, { id: "lease-detail" }, "de");
    expect(page).toMatchObject({ locale: "en", publicPath: "/handbuch#lease-detail" });
    expect(page.bodyMd).toContain("tenants, rent and documents");
  });

  test("read-page rejects an unknown id", async () => {
    const error = await stack.http.queryErr(READ_PAGE, { id: "missing" }, user);
    expect(error.code).toBe("not_found");
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import { createHandbookKnowledgeFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/handbook-knowledge";

// In an app this object is the output of `kumiko handbuch knowledge <config> --out <file>`.
const handbook = {
  defaultLocale: "en",
  locales: {
    en: [
      {
        id: "prozess-add-tenant",
        kind: "process" as const,
        title: "Add a tenant",
        questions: ["How do I add a tenant?"],
        screens: [],
        bodyMd: "Open the lease, choose Add tenant and confirm the change.",
      },
      {
        id: "lease-detail",
        kind: "screen" as const,
        title: "Lease",
        questions: [],
        screens: [],
        bodyMd: "The lease screen shows tenants, rent and documents.",
      },
    ],
    de: [
      {
        id: "prozess-add-tenant",
        kind: "process" as const,
        title: "Mieter hinzufügen",
        questions: ["Wie füge ich einen Mieter hinzu?"],
        screens: [],
        bodyMd: "Vertrag öffnen, Mieter hinzufügen wählen und die Änderung bestätigen.",
      },
    ],
  },
};

export const handbookKnowledgeFeature = createHandbookKnowledgeFeature({
  pages: handbook,
  access: { roles: ["User"] },
  publicPath: "/handbuch",
});
```
